name: Octree Connectivity Algorithm
aliases: Octree Connectivity Algorithm — Dual Vertex Connectivity, Lobello et al. Connectivity
definition: An algorithm to connect dual vertices by sequentially processing octree cells, ensuring each intercepted edge is processed exactly once by marking edges and cells.
summary: The Octree Connectivity Algorithm connects dual vertices into a manifold mesh by using a global edge marking system to ensure topological consistency across varying refinement levels.
